You are implementing two small changes to ONE file in the repo at /home/runner/workspace (branch fix/split-bill-pill). Work from /home/runner/workspace. React + TS + Vite + Framer Motion. Build: `npx vite build`. Run a test: `npx jest --verbose`. It has a `const PILL_BG = "#E9E9E6"` near the top, a `stats.map(...)` that renders each pill as a `
`, and a page-dots block below. ...
` to a `motion.div` with hover/tap, keeping ALL existing style properties (including the border/shadow you just added) unchanged: ```tsx ``` Close the element with ``. ### Verify - `npx jest client/src/pages/property/__tests__/stat-carousel.test.tsx --verbose` → PASS (the pageFromScroll tests are unaffected). - `npx vite build` → succeeds. ### Commit (single commit for both changes) ```bash git add client/src/pages/property/stat-carousel.tsx git commit -m "feat(dashboard): white carousel boxes with hover/press" ``` End the commit message with this trailer on its own line: Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 ## Report Report: **Status:** DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT, what changed, the jest result, the build result, the commit SHA, and any concerns.
